name: std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator<T>::delete_object

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
p

 -

 pointer to the object to destroy and deallocate

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function was introduced for use with the fully-specialized allocator std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator<>, but it may be useful in any specialization.

summary: Destroys the object of type U and deallocates storage allocated for it.
